title: Micron Stock News (Oct 16, 2026): MU Rises 1.9% to $931.24
summary: Micron (MU) closed at $931.24 on Oct 15, up 1.87%, recovering from a $858.00 low as memory stocks faced rate fears and CXMT competition worries.
body_markdown:
## Why Micron Stock Rose


No fetched source named a company-specific reason for Thursday's recovery, so the move reads best against the morning's selling and the wider market. As reported by[GuruFocus](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/ai/articles/micron-sandisk-sk-hynix-stocks-181511803.html) , Micron, SanDisk and SK Hynix all traded lower before the open as the[AI chip selloff](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/asia-chip-stock-rout-sk-hynix-samsung-softbank-on-rate-and-ai-funding-fears/) deepened, with investors worried that higher interest rates would make data-center construction more expensive, alongside a labor issue Micron faces in Taiwan and tougher competition from China's CXMT.


Per[Zacks](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/micron-sandisk-stocks-look-oversold-181300985.html) , concerns over CXMT's reported DRAM advances weighed on Micron and SanDisk during the week, though the outlet noted those advances have not yet shown commercial viability at scale. The rate backdrop softened by the close, with the US 10-year Treasury yield ending the session at 5.09%, down 10.1 basis points.


A second[GuruFocus report](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/micron-stocks-fall-although-35b-192544391.html) pointed to Micron's $35.16 billion repurchase authorization, approved by the board on October 8 according to the company's annual SEC filing. Purchases under the larger authorization can begin December 9, and CHIPS funding conditions cap buybacks against defined free cash flow.


## MU Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- According to Micron's[fiscal fourth-quarter 2026 release](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000723125/000072312526000018/a2026q4ex991-pressrelease.htm) , revenue hit a record $54.23 billion for the quarter ended September 3, 2026, and the company guided fiscal first-quarter 2027 revenue to $61.5 billion, plus or minus $1.5 billion.
- Micron said its projected high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity is sold out through 2027, as reported by GuruFocus.
- [The Motley Fool](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/just-bought-micron-stock-heres-200500083.html) reported that Micron has signed customer deals setting floor and ceiling prices for memory chips, with some running through 2031.


### Risks


- CXMT's DRAM progress could eventually pressure memory pricing, Zacks noted.
- Higher interest rates could raise data-center building costs and weigh on chip valuations, per GuruFocus.
- GuruFocus flagged an unresolved labor issue at Micron in Taiwan as a point to watch for disruption.
